Name: AT Rainbow Flamingoes
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Alternative Textures pack that allows you to recolor the lawn flamingo. There are 13 additional colors:
Dark Pink
Dark Purple
Light Purple
Dark Blue
Light Blue
Dark Green
Light Green
Orange
Yellow
Black/Gray
White
Brown
V 1.0.1 Update:
~Introducing~
Turquoise
Pearl
Void Essence
Iridium
Qi Gem
Radioactive
Void
Ectoplasm

Also all of the flamingoes can face both directions now, thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71419698]SarahHuis[/url] for the idea!
Additionally, all of the flamingoes can now be scarecrows. These retextures are available for the scarecrow, rarecrow, and deluxe scarecrow.

You can change the color of the flamingo with the paint bucket from Robin's.

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42177720]Fynzou[/url], who made the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2257]Flamingo Scarecrows[/url], which was what I based most of the colors on. Thank you for allowing your assets to be used!
